entries.title: Exodus 24:1
segments: Come up; this command was given to Moses while he was yet with God in the mount,
.  The meaning is, that he should come up again with the persons named, after he had first descended and done what is recorded in

. 
 
  Nadab and Abihu; the two elder sons of Aaron.
We should approach God not only with reverence and holy fear, but with filial respect, confidence, and love.

entries.title: Exodus 24:3
segments:
All the words of the Lord--the judgments; those contained in the four preceding chapters.  The ten commandments were spoken by God himself to all the people. 
 
We often find that many who are forward to promise are backward to perform, and that nothing but the grace of God will make those who solemnly covenant with him steadfast and persevering in obeying his commands.

entries.title: Exodus 24:4
segments: All the words of the Lord; those which he had previously communicated to the people.

entries.title: Exodus 24:7
segments: The book of the covenant; that which he had written.

entries.title: Exodus 24:8
segments: The blood of the covenant; that by which the covenant which they had made was ratified.

The blood which was shed in sacrifices under the Old Testament dispensation, was designed to impress upon all the necessity of an atonement, in order to the forgiveness of sin and acceptance with God. It pointed forward to the blood of Christ, who, in due time, was to take away sin by the sacrifice of himself; and who would enter the holy place with his own blood, and thus obtain eternal redemption for all who should believe on him.

entries.title: Exodus 24:9
segments: Then went up Moses; as directed,

entries.title: Exodus 24:10
segments: Saw the God of Israel; compare

. 
 
  A paved work of a sapphire; or, transparent sapphire.  This is the "sea of glass like unto crystal,'' in

.  The sapphire is a precious stone of a sky-blue color.  The elders of Israel did not see God face to face as Moses did, but only from the lower part of the mount, where they were commanded to worship "afar off."

entries.title: Exodus 24:11
segments: He laid not his hand; they received no harm, though they saw God; not his essence or shape, but his visible glory.

entries.title: Exodus 24:12
segments:
Come up to me; still nearer to the visible glory. 
 
  Tables of stone; on which were the ten commandments.

. 
 
A right understanding of the law which God wrote with his finger on tables of stone, is essential to a right estimate of human character. Ministers should therefore be very explicit in teaching it.  Without rightly understanding the law, men will not rightly understand the gospel, or their need of its blessings.

entries.title: Exodus 24:13
segments:
Minister; servant. 
 
  Into the mount; towards the top of the mount, on which was the visible presence of Jehovah.  It would seem that Moses with Joshua approached near to the cloud that covered the mount, and there abode six days.  On the seventh day God called Moses into his immediate presence, while Joshua remained behind and waited for him.  In
, we find him descending with Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 24:14
segments: Matters to do; controversies to be settled, or cases to be decided.

entries.title: Exodus 24:18
segments: Moses received his directions from God, therefore all the children of Israel were bound to obey him.  If they did not, they rebelled against God, and were justly exposed to his wrath.  How much more aggravated will be the sin and doom of men who refuse to obey Jesus Christ.
